music-ui.title: Music UI
music-ui.description: Elevate your Minecraft interface to the next level with Music UI! Designed to provide fluid, minimalist navigation with a unique musical aesthetic.

screenshots.title: Main Screen
screenshots.description: The main screen of Music UI showcases a clean and intuitive layout, allowing users to easily navigate through their music library and access various features.

screenshots.title: Playlist Screen
screenshots.description: The playlist screen provides a visually appealing interface for managing and organizing playlists, with options to add, remove, and rearrange songs.

screenshots.title: About Modal
screenshots.description: The about modal offers users information about the Music UI project, including version details, credits, and links to support and feedback channels.

screenshots.title: Tooltip Modal
screenshots.description: The tooltip modal provides helpful hints and explanations for various features and controls within the Music UI, enhancing user understanding and usability.

better-chat.title: BetterChat+++
better-chat.description: A complete overhaul of the chat interface, providing a more intuitive and user-friendly experience with improved readability and customizable options.

screenshots.title: Chat Screen (Main)
screenshots.description: The main chat screen has been redesigned for improved readability and ease of use.

screenshots.title: Chat Screen (Sidebar)
screenshots.description: Here is a preview of the new custom chat sidebar UI with coordinates, quick notes, and a built-in calculator!

screenshots.title: Chat Screen (Settings)
screenshots.description: The settings menu allows for customization of chat appearance and behavior.

thony-ui.title: Thony UI
thony-ui.description: A sleek and modern interface overhaul. Designed to provide a clean, professional, and clutter-free experience by completely redesigning every menu and HUD element for maximum clarity.

screenshots.title: Start Screen
screenshots.description: You'll be greeted with smooth motions and elegant transitions.

screenshots.title: Play Screen
screenshots.description: The roster has been completely redesigned with a visual touch.

screenshots.title: Play Screen (Menu Options)
screenshots.description: The play screen has been redesigned to visually highlight each world.

screenshots.title: Play Screen (Servers List)
screenshots.description: The server list has been enhanced for easier navigation.

screenshots.title: Chat Screen
screenshots.description: The chat screen has been revamped to offer a cleaner interface.

screenshots.title: Pause Screen
screenshots.description: The pause menu now has a fresh, modern new look.

music-ore-ui.title: Music Ore-UI
music-ore-ui.description: The Music Ore-Ui offers a sleek and modern interface that enhances the user experience with its intuitive design and easy-to-use controls.

screenshots.title: Music Screen (Main)
screenshots.description: The music player includes a variety of elements such as playback controls, customizable playlists, and an intuitive interface.

screenshots.title: Music Screen (Tip)
screenshots.description: This screen provides a helpful tip for users, showcasing how to efficiently use the music player interface.

screenshots.title: Music Screen (About)
screenshots.description: This screen provides detailed information about the music player, including its features and usage instructions.
